edge_cases: row 0's query aligns strongly with the LAST key (last tile, j=48..63) -- forces the running max to be updated (and the accumulator/sum rescaled) on the FINAL tile, the case a missing/short-circuited rescale is most likely to break
DH=64 is exactly one 64-lane fp16 HVX vector -- no tail/padding on the head-dim axis
SK/FLASH_TILE_K=4 tiles per query row -- at least one real rescale (running max increases) is exercised across the sweep
exp() is unavoidably scalar (no HVX vector transcendental); only the QK^T dot-reduce, the rescale-multiply, and the weighted-V accumulate/normalize are vectorized (qf16 chain)
nearmiss_no_rescale computes corr=exp(m_old-m_new) but never applies it to the old running sum/accumulator (classic flash-attention bug) -> INCORRECT (567/1024 wrong)
